subject: Post-demo: API guardrails, SDK install, and short-lived creds plan
messages:

Subject: Post-demo: API guardrails, SDK install, and short-lived creds plan

Thanks again for the demo time earlier today — appreciate Samir and Elena walking us through the payments flow and where inference will sit (pre-authorization routing + risk scoring). Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have an operational path forward: 

What we covered (short):
- Integration surface: server-to-server calls from your routing service -> Redwood hosted endpoints for embeddings + re-ranker + decisioning model.
- SDKs: Node (npm) and Python (pip) quickstarts. We demonstrated the JS client running a batched embed -> rerank flow.
- Auth options discussed: API keys (simple), service accounts + short-lived JWTs (recommended), OIDC delegation for Vault-backed workflows.

Redwood recommendation (recommended path):
1) Use service-account-based short-lived credentials (20 min TTL tokens) minted by your STS/OIDC provider. This avoids long-lived keys in your app and plugs into Vault if you already have that.
2) Boot via Redwood SDK for batching/structured-output support — SDK handles KV cache and streaming.
3) Routing: add a per-tenant header for model selection; Redwood will honor header routing for canary/fallbacks.

Attachments I shared: redwood-sdk-quickstart.pdf, api-auth-diagram.png (auth flow sketch).

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Samir / Elena: confirm which infra you want to use for token minting (HashiVault STS vs cloud provider STS) and who will own the service account.
- ClearWave infra owner: provide sample SAML/OIDC metadata and any constraints (proxy, egress rules).
- Redwood technical owner (Karthik): schedule a 60-minute token-exchange tech call next week to walk through OIDC claims and audience shims.
- Procurement: Elena / procurement@clearwave.com to flag if we need a statement-of-work for dedicated support or any regulatory addenda.

Suggested timeline: tech call by June 16, SDK trial in staging by June 23, production smoke by July 8.

If that all sounds good I can open a short mutual action plan doc and assign owners.

—

Samir — great questions, answered inline below and attaching a tiny example (sts-token-sample.txt) that mirrors what we typically expect.

Q1 — sample for token exchange: attached sts-token-sample.txt includes an example Vault role that uses the "vault/sts" pattern to mint a shortlived JWT with claims: iss (your Vault), sub (svc-account@clearwave), aud (https://api.redwood.com/token-exchange). The SDK can accept that JWT directly in Authorization: Bearer <token>.

Q2 — accepted formats / claims: we accept standard OIDC JWTs. Requirements:
- audience must match the token-exchange endpoint (see above)
- exp must be <= 30 minutes (we recommend 15–20m)
- token signed by an IDP with a rotating key set (jwks).
We also support an alternative where you post a short-lived signed assertion to Redwood's exchange endpoint and we mint an internal session token for 20m.

Q3 — rotation: recommended patterns:
- If using Vault STS (preferred): you rotate on your side automatically (Vault issues ephemeral tokens) — Redwood does not need the long-lived secret and nothing to rotate on our side.
- If you choose long-lived service account keys (not recommended): rotate monthly at minimum; Redwood can integrate with your rotation webhook to accept push updates, but ClearWave must store the long-lived key in a secure KMS and push when rotated.

Operational owners / asks: 
- Karthik Iyer (Redwood) to lead SDK integration and provide a step-by-step sample for Node + Python by June 16.
- Ben Carter (Redwood) to produce a lightweight runbook for rotation and incident steps for credential compromise by June 18.
- Samir / ClearWave: share Vault role config and any firewall/proxy constraints before the tech call.

Proposed tech call times (PDT): June 16 10:00–11:00, June 16 14:00–15:00, or June 17 09:00–10:00 — please confirm availability.

Attachments: sts-token-sample.txt (sample Vault role + token), referenced SDK snippets are in the shared Drive link I posted earlier.
